description: Change a saved test when the app changed on purpose: find a step a new way (selector, text, anyOf), put in steps or checks, with a `reason` and the pull request in `pr`. Never weakens a check, an absent check included; the revised test is replayed first and only a pass saves. `undo` takes a change back.

address.description: Where to replay the revised test, when it is not the pull request's preview or the app's usual address.

addExpect.description: A check to put in: what the screen then shows, or with `absent` what it no longer shows.

absent.description: With `text` or `selector`: true puts in a check that it is NOT on the page (confirmed not visible within about two seconds), such as "Untitled form" after a delete.

addStep.description: A step to put in, as create_test takes it: { action: "click", text: "Open menu" }.

after.description: With `addStep` or `addExpect`: put it after this step (0 puts it first).

remove.description: Refused for every step: a person removes steps, on the test's page.

replace.description: Write the step again, whole. A check can only be written again as a check that asks for at least the same.

retarget.description: Find this step a new way. Its action and its words stay; only how it is found changes.

anyOf.description: Several ways to find it, tried in order: the new one first, then the old, so staging keeps passing until the change is merged. Each is { selector } or { text }.

text.description: The words a person reads on or beside it: its visible label, its button text.
The new visible words (a field's label, a button's text).

step.description: With `retarget`, `replace` or `remove`: the step number, counted from 1, as the report and the test page number it.

changes.description: What to change: re-target a step (selector, text, anyOf), add steps, add expects. Step numbers are the test's own now. Send a list, or that list as JSON text.

pr.description: The pull request that made the change. Its preview is where the revised test is replayed, and its next check says the test was updated and why.

reason.description: Why the test changes, in a sentence a teammate can read in the test's history: "Solivo PR #651 replaced the hidden aria-label with a visible label." Required with `changes`.

repo.description: The app, as "owner/name". Left out, the workspace's only app.

test.description: The test to change: its id, or its name as about_app lists it.

undo.description: Take back a change: the revision id update_test answered with. Send it with `test` and nothing else.

name: update_test
